title: Preserve reconnect backoff across an immediate first-health success
outcome: A flapping peer cannot reset reconnect backoff merely by passing the immediate first health; subsequent health waits at least one probe interval before resetting.
acceptance: A deterministic production-monitor regression models repeated short-lived healthy connections and proves backoff grows despite the immediate first probe.
A stable connection still resets backoff after the intended minimum uptime, and stop/control-stream completion remains bounded.
